2608.31119.title: PaperGym: Rubric-Centered Evolution for Research-Plan Generation
2608.31119.paper_summary: Research planning is the decisive capability of AI scientists. Yet a research plan admits no verifiable answer, so reinforcement learning lacks the environment it requires: tasks paired with a critic. Rubrics extracted from scientific papers can supply the critic. Existing pipelines, however, draw the question and the criteria from the same content, so the reward can be earned by paraphrase. The rubric is further compressed into a single scalar per rollout. We introduce PaperGym, a unified framework that turns each research paper into a complete training environment. PaperGym exploits the structure of a paper: the question is synthesized from the research goal and background, while the criteria are derived from the method and experiments. The criteria span methodological innovation and experimental design, and criterion leakage falls to 3.7%, versus 11.90% to 34.10% in existing datasets. Training uses the rubric twice: first as privileged context for OPSD's self-teacher, then as the reward for GRPO. Across Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B, this schedule outperforms supervised fine-tuning, either stage alone, and the reverse ordering, improving five-benchmark averages by +5.6, +5.0, and +4.8 points. With the recipe held fixed, models trained on PaperGym-20k win 58.1% of three-way comparisons, against 28.2% for RubricHub Science. The trained Qwen3-8B reaches 73.48 on ResearchQA, above the far larger Kimi K2.6. We release the pipeline, the 20,000-instance corpus PaperGym-20k, and the benchmarks PaperGym-Innov and PaperGym-Design.
2608.31119.paper_summary_zh: 研究規劃是人工智慧科學家的關鍵能力。<lb/>然而，研究計劃並不承認可驗證的答案，因此強化學習缺乏所需的環境：與評論者配對的任務。<lb/>從科學論文中提取的評分標準可以提供評論者。<lb/>然而，現有的流程從相同的內容中提取問題和標準，因此獎勵可以通過改寫來獲得。<lb/>評分標準進一步壓縮為每次展開的一個標量。<lb/>我們介紹了PaperGym，一個統一的框架，將每篇研究論文轉化為完整的訓練環境。<lb/>PaperGym利用論文的結構：問題是從研究目標和背景合成的，而標準則是從方法和實驗中得出的。<lb/>這些標準涵蓋了方法論創新和實驗設計，標準洩漏率降至3.7%，而現有數據集的洩漏率則在11.90%到34.10%之間。<lb/>訓練使用評分標準兩次：第一次作為OPSD自我教師的特權上下文，然後作為GRPO的獎勵。<lb/>在Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B中，這一日程超越了監督微調，無論是單獨的階段，還是反向排序，五個基準平均提高了+5.6、+5.0和+4.8分。<lb/>在配方固定的情況下，基於PaperGym-20k訓練的模型在三方比較中獲得了58.1%的勝率，而RubricHub Science則為28.2%。<lb/>訓練後的Qwen3-8B在ResearchQA上達到了73.48，超過了更大的Kimi K2.6。<lb/>我們發布了這一流程、20,000實例的語料庫PaperGym-20k，以及基準PaperGym-Innov和PaperGym-Design。
